texts.arguments: 5. The learned counsel for the petitioner brought to the notice of this Court that two meetings were held with the Tea Board of India during the year 2024 and 2025 and it was agreed upon that a SOP can be brought out in order to ensure that the tea samples that are taken for regulatory testing is tested without giving rise to any discrepancies.
